Definition: of uncertain affinity; a particle of succession (in time or logical enumeration), then, moreover:--after that(-ward), furthermore, then. See also G1899.
BiblicalUsage: Then is the word of what happens next, and the Gospels use it for the quiet steps of the story. Jesus rises from supper and then pours water into a basin to wash His disciples' feet, and from the cross He says to John, Behold thy mother, and from that hour John takes her to his own home. Paul says Christ was seen by Cephas, then by the twelve, and James says lust conceives and brings forth sin, and sin, when it is finished, brings forth death.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the then after Jesus' words is where obedience lives, because He washed feet and then we must, and He spoke from the cross and then John obeyed. My position is that the next step is always the one in front of me.
